SELECT e.name FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o1.customer_id) AS n FROM orders o1 WHERE o1.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o1.order_date < '2025-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.customer_id = o1.customer_id AND o2.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o2.order_date < '2026-01-01')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE segment = 'retail'

SELECT ci.name FROM customers cu JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = cu.city_id WHERE cu.name = 'Qahtani Trading Est.'
SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = e.city_id WHERE e.role = 'support_agent' AND ci.name = 'Tabuk' ORDER BY e.name

SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost), 2) AS margin FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

WITH rev AS (SELECT substr(o.order_date,6,2) AS m, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY m), ref AS (SELECT substr(o.order_date,6,2) AS m, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS refunds FROM returns rt JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = rt.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY m), q AS (SELECT CASE WHEN rev.m IN ('01','02','03') THEN 'Q1' WHEN rev.m IN ('04','05','06') THEN 'Q2' WHEN rev.m IN ('07','08','09') THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS quarter, rev.revenue AS revenue, COALESCE(ref.refunds,0) AS refunds FROM rev LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.m = rev.m) SELECT quarter FROM q GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY SUM(refunds) / SUM(revenue) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH closed AS (SELECT customer_id, (julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24 AS hrs FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(hrs) AS a FROM closed), cust AS (SELECT customer_id FROM closed GROUP BY customer_id HAVING AVG(hrs) > (SELECT a FROM overall)) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cust WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2)

SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2027-01-01')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NULL AND topic = 'product_question'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cities ci JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE r.name = 'Riyadh'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.segment = 'retail' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'

SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) AS month FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY substr(o.order_date,1,7) ORDER BY CAST(SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM returns r WHERE r.order_item_id = oi.id)) AS REAL) / COUNT(oi.id) DESC, month LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.segment = 'retail' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-07-01'

SELECT q.quarter FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_date < '2025-04-01' THEN 'Q1' WHEN o.order_date < '2025-07-01' THEN 'Q2' WHEN o.order_date < '2025-10-01' THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS quarter, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1) q JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_date < '2025-04-01' THEN 'Q1' WHEN o.order_date < '2025-07-01' THEN 'Q2' WHEN o.order_date < '2025-10-01' THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS quarter, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS ref FROM returns rt JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = rt.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1) f ON f.quarter = q.quarter ORDER BY f.ref / q.rev DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ci.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-07-01' GROUP BY ci.id ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC, ci.name LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'SMSA' AND shipped_at >= '2024-01-01' AND shipped_at < '2025-01-01'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments WHERE method = 'bank_transfer' AND paid_at >= '2024-07-01' AND paid_at < '2024-10-01'

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS r25, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-07-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS r24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY r.id) WHERE r24 > 0 ORDER BY (r25 - r24) / r24 ASC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Asir' AND o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'

SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) AS month FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY substr(o.order_date,1,7) ORDER BY COUNT(rt.id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.id) DESC, month LIMIT 1

SELECT o.channel FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) DESC, o.channel LIMIT 1

SELECT segment FROM (SELECT c.segment AS segment, SUM(oi.quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS avg_units FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.segment) ORDER BY avg_units DESC, segment LIMIT 1

WITH rev AS (SELECT (CAST(substr(o.order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER)+2)/3 AS q, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount_pct/100.0)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY q), ref AS (SELECT (CAST(substr(o.order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER)+2)/3 AS q, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS refunds FROM returns rt JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id=rt.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status='delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY q) SELECT 'Q'||rev.q AS quarter FROM rev LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.q=rev.q ORDER BY COALESCE(ref.refunds,0)/rev.revenue DESC, rev.q LIMIT 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS r24, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS r25 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.id) WHERE r24 > 0 AND r25 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (r25 - r24) / r24 DESC, name LIMIT 1

WITH ct AS (SELECT customer_id, (julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24 AS h FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), cust AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG(h) AS avg_h FROM ct GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cust WHERE avg_h > (SELECT AVG(h) FROM ct) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = cust.customer_id) >= 8

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS r24, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS r25 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.id) WHERE r24 IS NOT NULL AND r24 > 0 ORDER BY (COALESCE(r25, 0) - r24) / r24 ASC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS h2_25, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS h2_24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.id) WHERE h2_24 IS NOT NULL AND h2_24 > 0 ORDER BY (COALESCE(h2_25, 0) - h2_24) / h2_24 ASC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS r25, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS r24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.id) ORDER BY (r25 - r24) * 1.0 / NULLIF(r24, 0) DESC, name LIMIT 1
